strings.notes_body: Zolemba zimasungidwa pa chipangizo. Maziko awa akonzedwa pa zolemba zokonzedwa, zikumbutso, mawu ndi kusintha mawu kukhala zolemba mtsogolo.

strings.notes_search_empty_body: Yesani mawu ena osaka kapena chotsani kusaka.
strings.settings_diagnostics_notes_body: Zochitika zopanga, kusintha, kusunga, kufufuta, kusunga zobwezeretsera ndi kubwezeretsa zolemba.
strings.notes_runtime_log_empty_body: Pangani, sinthani kapena sungani zolemba ndipo mbiri ya zochitika idzaoneka pano.
strings.notes_diagnostics_actions_body: Koperani, chotsani kapena tumizani lipoti lapano lozindikira mavuto a zolemba.

strings.notes_unsaved_changes_body: Sungani zosintha musanachoke pa cholemba ichi?

strings.notes_advance_reminder_unavailable_past: Palibe nthawi yomwe ilipo chochitikachi chisanachitike. Chotsani chochitikacho kupita mtsogolo kaye.

strings.notes_voice_transcript_architecture_read: Zolemba zochokera ku mawu zakonzedwa ngati mtundu wapadera wa cholemba. Kuzindikira mawu kudzalumikizidwa pa gawo lotsatira.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_ready: Dinani Yambani kuzindikira ndipo lankhulani. Mungasinthe zotsatira pamanja musanasunge.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_backup_ready: Mawu a zolemba ndi metadata amaphatikizidwa mu kusunga ndi kubwezeretsa.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_placehold: Mitundu ya mawu yopanda intaneti idzalumikizidwa mtsogolo.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_dictation_active_: Kulemba mawu kumapitiriza mpaka mutadina Imitsani.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_settings_body: Kuzindikira pa intaneti nthawi zambiri kumakhala kolondola chifukwa kungagwiritse ntchito dongosolo kapena mtambo wa chipangizo. Njira yopanda intaneti imagwira popanda intaneti, koma khalidwe lingakhale lotsika chifukwa kukonza kumachitika pa foni ndipo kumadalira mtundu wosankhidwa.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_model_mis: Mtundu wopanda intaneti sunakhazikitsidwe. Kutsitsa kudzawonjezedwa pa gawo la offline.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_settings_locked: Zokonda sizingasinthidwe kulemba mawu kukugwira. Imitsani kaye kuzindikira.
strings.notes_transcript_offline_model_missing: Mtundu wa mawu wopanda intaneti sunakhazikitsidwe.
strings.settings_speech_models_button_body: Tsitsani ndi kusamalira mitundu yosandutsa mawu kukhala zolemba popanda intaneti.
strings.settings_speech_models_header_body: Tsitsani mitundu ya mawu kuti muzindikire mawu popanda intaneti. Mitunduyo imasungidwa pa chipangizo ndipo imatsimikizidwa ndi SHA-256 isanakhazikitsidwe.
strings.settings_speech_models_load_failed: Sitinathe kutsegula manifest ya mitundu ya mawu. Yang'anani intaneti yanu ndipo yesaninso.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_no_models: Palibe mitundu yopanda intaneti yokhazikitsidwa. Tsegulani Mitundu ya mawu yopanda intaneti mu Zokonda ndipo tsitsani kaye mtundu.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_h: Kuzindikira popanda intaneti kumagwira popanda intaneti. Khalidwe limadalira mtundu wosankhidwa, mphamvu ya foni ndi mmene maikolofoni ilili. Kuti mupeze kulondola kwambiri, gwiritsani kuzindikira pa intaneti.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_s: Khalidwe lopanda intaneti lingakhale lotsika kuposa la pa intaneti chifukwa kukonza kumachitika pa foni.
strings.geo_alarm_empty_title: Palibe ma alamu a malo pano
strings.geo_alarm_empty_body: Pangani alamu yochokera pa malo yolowera kapena kutuluka m'dera losankhidwa.
strings.geo_alarm_stage1_body: Gawoli limasunga ma alamu a malo, kuzindikira mavuto ndi deta yosunga. Zilolezo za malo ndi kutumiza kwa geofence kwenikweni zidzalumikizidwa pa gawo lotsatira.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_latitude: Latitude iyenera kukhala pakati pa -90 ndi 90.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_longitude: Longitude iyenera kukhala pakati pa -180 ndi 180.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_data: Yang'anani deta ya alamu ya malo ndipo yesaninso.
strings.settings_diagnostics_geo_alarm: Kuzindikira mavuto a alamu ya malo
strings.settings_diagnostics_geo_alarm_body: Kupanga, kusintha, kusunga, kubwezeretsa ndi zochitika zamtsogolo zotumiza geofence.
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_log_title: Mbiri yozindikira mavuto a alamu ya malo
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_log_empty_body: Pangani kapena sinthani ma alamu a malo ndipo mbiri ya zochitika idzaoneka pano.
strings.geo_alarm_diagnostics_clear_confirm_titl: Chotsani mbiri yozindikira mavuto a alamu ya malo?
strings.geo_alarm_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Zochitika zonse zosungidwa za alamu ya malo zidzafufutidwa kwamuyaya.
strings.geo_alarm_stage2_body: Zilolezo za malo ndi kulembetsa geofence zalumikizidwa. Dera losungidwa likayambitsa, pulogalamu imalemba kuzindikira mavuto ndi kuwonetsa chidziwitso. Kulira kwathunthu kudzalumikizidwa pa gawo lotsatira.
strings.geo_alarm_notification_channel_descripti: Zidziwitso za ma alamu ochokera pa malo
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_package2_body: Kulembetsa geofence, kubwezeretsa poyatsa, wolandira kusintha, kuzindikira mavuto ndi kutumiza zidziwitso zayatsidwa.
strings.geo_alarm_reliability_body: Ma alamu ochokera pa malo amafuna kufikira malo, malo akumbuyo ndi zidziwitso. Android ikhoza kuchedwetsabe zochitika za geofence kuti isunge batire.

strings.geo_alarm_permission_background_missing: Lolani nthawi zonse mu zokonda za pulogalamu
strings.geo_alarm_vendor_hint_body: Pa Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO, MIUI kapena HyperOS, lolaninso kuyambitsa kokha ndi kuchotsa malire a batire a ShiftAlarm. Apo ayi zochitika za geofence zingafike mochedwa.
strings.geo_alarm_stage21_body: Gawoli limawonjezera njira zazifupi za zilolezo, malangizo odalirika ndi kuzindikira mavuto kwatsatanetsatane. Kulira kwathunthu kudzalumikizidwa tikatsimikizira mmene geofence imagwirira ntchito.

strings.settings_permissions_geo_first_launch_bo: Ma alamu a malo amafuna kufikira malo, malo enieni ndi malo akumbuyo kuti ayambitse pulogalamu ikatsekedwa. Mungayatse izi mu zokonda za pulogalamu.
strings.settings_permissions_unrestricted_body: Kuti ma alamu ndi ma alamu a malo azigwira modalirika, chotsani malire a batire a ShiftAlarm. Pa Xiaomi/Redmi ndi zida zofanana, lolaninso kuyambitsa kokha kapena kugwira kumbuyo ngati kulipo.

strings.legal_documents_intro_body: Zikalata zilipo popanda intaneti. Intaneti ikapezeka, ShiftAlarm ingatsitse mitundu yatsopano ndi kugwiritsa ntchito makope omangidwamo ngati njira ina.

strings.legal_document_unavailable_body: Chikalatacho sichinatseguke. Yang'anani intaneti kapena yesaninso mtsogolo.
strings.onboarding_step_welcome_title: Tsamba lanu la tsiku la sifiti
strings.onboarding_step_welcome_body: ShiftAlarm imaphatikiza ndandanda za masifiti, ma alamu, ma alamu a malo, zolemba, ma widget ndi zida zosunga. Tsamba lalikulu lilipo kale kumbuyo kwa zenera lokhazikitsali.
strings.onboarding_step_documents_body: Tsegulani zikalata za pulogalamu ndipo vomerezani mitundu yofunika. Zimafotokoza malamulo ogwiritsira ntchito, zachinsinsi ndi malire a kudalirika kwa ma alamu, zidziwitso ndi ma alamu a malo.
strings.onboarding_step_permissions_body: Zilolezo sizofunika kuti muwone pulogalamu, koma ma alamu, zikumbutso ndi ma alamu a malo zimadalira zidziwitso, ma alamu a nthawi yeniyeni, malo ndi zokonda za batire.
strings.onboarding_permissions_finish_hint: Mungamalize tsopano ndi kubwerera ku zilolezo mtsogolo kuchokera ku Zokonda.

strings.help_training_offer_body: Tsegulani buku la wogwiritsa ntchito kuti mudziwe ntchito ya gawo lililonse lalikulu, komwe lili, zomwe mungadine ndi zomwe mungayang'ane ngati china sichikugwira bwino.
